stories.title: Manchester City found guilty of breaking Premier League’s financial fair play rules

en.title: Manchester City found guilty of breaking Premier League's financial fair play rules
en.summary: An independent panel found Manchester City guilty on nearly all of over 100 charges related to financial fair play rule breaches. The club faces substantial sanctions and has indicated it plans to appeal the verdict.

stories.title: Manchester City found guilty of 114 financial charges in seismic EPL ruling

en.title: Manchester City found guilty of 114 financial charges in seismic EPL ruling
en.summary: Manchester City has been found guilty of 114 financial charges. The club may face penalties ranging from fines to points deductions or expulsion from the Premier League, though it is expected to appeal.

stories.title: Socceroos denied famous win as late Brazil goal cancels out Irankunda stunner

en.title: Socceroos denied famous win as late Brazil goal cancels out Irankunda stunner
en.summary: Australia and Brazil drew 1-1 in an international friendly, with Nestory Irankunda's free kick cancelled out by Rayan's late equaliser. Australia came close to a notable victory against Brazil's star-studded squad.

stories.title: Last-minute Rayan equaliser denies Socceroos famous win against Brazil

en.title: Last-minute Rayan equaliser denies Socceroos famous win against Brazil
en.summary: Australia conceded a late equaliser to Brazil in a friendly match after leading through Nestory Irankunda's free kick, missing the chance for a significant victory.

stories.title: Nawaqanitawase genius helps Roosters sink Dolphins and reach NRL grand final

en.title: Nawaqanitawase genius helps Roosters sink Dolphins and reach NRL grand final
en.summary: Sydney Roosters defeated Dolphins 36-20 in the NRL preliminary final to secure their first grand final appearance in seven years, with Mark Nawaqanitawase scoring twice and Sam Walker returning from injury.

stories.title: Irankunda stuns Brazil with epic free kick

en.title: Irankunda stuns Brazil with epic free kick
en.summary: Nestory Irankunda scored a remarkable free kick to give the Socceroos a lead against Brazil.

stories.title: Nawaqanitawase-inspired Roosters into grand final after dominating Dolphins

en.title: Nawaqanitawase-inspired Roosters into grand final after dominating Dolphins
en.summary: Mark Nawaqanitawase scored two tries and created another as the Sydney Roosters defeated the Dolphins to advance to the grand final.

stories.title: Collins crashes over as Roosters eye grand final

en.title: Collins crashes over as Roosters eye grand final
en.summary: Lindsay Collins scored a try against three defenders, moving the Roosters closer to securing a grand final spot.

stories.title: Late Brazil goal denies Socceroos famous win after stunning Irankunda free kick

en.title: Late Brazil goal denies Socceroos famous win after stunning Irankunda free kick
en.summary: Brazil scored in the final moments to prevent the Socceroos from winning after Nestory Irankunda's exceptional free kick had given Australia the lead.

stories.title: Red-hot Roosters roar into NRL grand final

en.title: Red-hot Roosters roar into NRL grand final
en.summary: The Roosters defeated the Dolphins at Lang Park to become the first team to advance to the NRL grand final.

stories.title: Fremantle has already turned purple. A grand final win would send the port city into meltdown | Brendan Foster

en.title: Fremantle has already turned purple. A grand final win would send the port city into meltdown | Brendan Foster
en.summary: Following Fremantle's preliminary final victory over the Swans, supporters celebrated throughout the city's streets, with fans anticipating an end to the club's 32-year premiership drought at the upcoming grand final.

stories.title: Lachie Neale cleared to play in AFL grand final after overturning one-game suspension

en.title: Lachie Neale cleared to play in AFL grand final after overturning one-game suspension
en.summary: Brisbane midfielder Lachie Neale successfully appealed his suspension and was cleared to play in the AFL grand final against Fremantle after a striking charge was downgraded.

en.title: Trump tells Xi that support for Iran is unacceptable
en.summary: The US president conveyed to China's leader that Chinese support for Iran is unacceptable, while Iran has made a separate proposal concerning the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Top ANZ bankers in HK, Singapore and Sydney to exit

en.title: Top ANZ bankers in HK, Singapore and Sydney to exit
en.summary: At least 10 senior bankers are departing ANZ across Hong Kong, Singapore and Sydney as part of CEO Nuno Matos' restructuring of the bank, including executives John Corrin and Andrew Harward.

en.summary: The loss of sensitive Australian F-35 components has prompted renewed examination of China's efforts to obtain technology from America's stealth fighter jet.

en.summary: A proposal to move the AFL grand final to Sunday and relocate the public holiday to Monday has received mixed reactions from industry observers.
